newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Novellus estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Novellus estimates raised.

text.p: SoundView Financial Group Inc said Thursday it was raising its earnings estimates on Novellus Systems Inc and keeping its short and long-term buy rating on the shares.
-- Analyst Michael O'Brien said he raised his 1997 earnings estimates to $4.38 per share from $4.27 per share and his 1998 estimate to $6.13 per share from $5.75 per share.
-- O'Brien said he was hearing bookings were strong in the first half of the year, which was driving top line growth.
-- He said the company was maintaining market share in most of its product lines.
